name: benchmark-nanoscifact
description: A domain-specific benchmark focused on factual verification and question-answering in nanoscience. It evaluates model ability to judge or answer scientific claims and facts relevant to nanoscale materials and processes. The dataset targets models' specialized factual and scientific knowledge rather than general commonsense reasoning.
reputation: Niche, domain-specific benchmark used by researchers interested in scientific fact-checking in nanoscience but not widely adopted in broader benchmarking suites.
